cands.bio: Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 67 since 2017, first elected in a special election. Attorney who practices law in Selma and has served as a municipal judge in Selma.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Prince Chestnut was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. The pages we had gave no record of the bills he sponsored, and no statements or actions on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or school choice. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026. We found no controversies, but our sources were thin.

qual.background: Alabama House member since April 2017 (nine years), practicing attorney in Selma, and Selma municipal judge. His committee assignments have included House Judiciary and Ways and Means Education.
qual.why: He has held a legislative seat for about nine years and has a law career, which falls in the high band for writing law and budgets. Committee seats were not counted toward the score.
